selector.title: Find my model (wireless)
selector.lead: Answer five short questions. We suggest up to 3 current access points; models that are no longer sold are never shown.
selector.q.env: 1. Where will the access point go?
selector.q.poe: 3. How much power (PoE) does your switch give over the network cable?
selector.q.density: 4. How many people will connect at once?
selector.q.future: 5. How important is the newest technology?
selector.o.future.sixghz: I want the 6 GHz band (Wi-Fi 6E or 7)
selector.pending: Pick your answers and press "Suggest models".
selector.none: No current model fits these answers. Change an answer and try again.
selector.assumption.1: Only models that are on sale (current) are suggested.
selector.assumption.2: The number of people is judged roughly by the radio and stream count; this is not a Cisco sizing figure.
selector.assumption.3: The power class you pick is compared with the class the model needs for full function.
selector.assumption.4: The licence, the regulatory code added to the ordering code and the real cabling must be confirmed per project.
selector.relaxed.density: No model fits your number of people exactly, so the closest models are shown.
selector.relaxed.poe: No model works fully on the power you picked, so the closest models are shown; see the PoE warnings.
selector.why.recommended: the recommended model of its series
selector.why.mgmt.unified: can be managed on-premises or in the cloud
selector.warn.poe-short: Warning: full function needs {need}; on your switch some features are off or the speed drops.
selector.warn.poe-needed: Note: full function needs {need}. Check that your switch provides it.
selector.warn.six-ghz-turkey: Confirm the 6 GHz status in Türkiye: its use depends on BTK rules.
compare.title: Compare
compare.lead: See 2 to 4 models side by side. Your selection lives in the link in the address bar, so you can share it.
compare.empty: You have not picked any model yet. Tick the "Compare" boxes on the wireless page.
compare.one: One model is selected. Add at least one more to compare.
compare.noDiff: The models you picked are the same on these rows.
compare.nojs: The comparison table needs JavaScript. You can read each model on its own detail page.
